name: BDD100K Road Scene Lab
qualification: Selected-video inference is verified only with the declared local CUDA prerequisites and user-acquired inputs. Acquisition is not a model-quality or rights qualification.

environment.python: CPython 3.12 on Linux x86-64 with a compatible CUDA runtime
environment.accelerator: CUDA-capable NVIDIA GPU; the qualified run used an RTX 4080 SUPER
dependencies: PyTorch compatible with the host CUDA runtime
environment.installation: Create the isolated environment, then install the MeMOTR requirements and compatible CUDA/PyTorch build by following the pinned upstream instructions. ModelForge does not change CUDA or the host environment.

acquisitions.name: MeMOTR source
acquisitions.access: Public source checkout; network access is required only for an explicit fetch.
acquisitions.instructions: Fetch the pinned detached checkout or bind an existing clean checkout at the exact commit.

acquisitions.name: BDD100K MOT video data
acquisitions.access: Official access and BDD100K terms apply; ModelForge does not authenticate, accept terms, or download the data.
acquisitions.instructions: Acquire the required video and annotation release from the official portal, then bind its absolute local root with --use bdd100k-data=PATH.

acquisitions.name: MeMOTR BDD100K checkpoint
acquisitions.access: The upstream repository links this object but publishes no checksum or separate weight license; the digest is ModelForge's observed identity and BDD100K-derived-weight terms remain unresolved.
acquisitions.instructions: Acquire the checkpoint manually from the upstream link, verify the recorded SHA-256, and bind the exact file with --use memotr-checkpoint=PATH.

actions.qualification: A bounded checkpoint-bound selected-video run passed through the shared managed lifecycle on the declared local CUDA environment.
